content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-science-photosynthesis","title":"Photosynthesis","quick":"Plants make their own food using sunlight, water and carbon dioxide, in their leaves, releasing oxygen. This happens mainly in green leaves because of chlorophyll.","full":"Think of a leaf like a tiny kirana shop kitchen. It takes in raw materials: water from roots, carbon dioxide from air through tiny holes, and sunlight as energy. Chlorophyll, the green colour in leaves, captures the sunlight. Inside the leaf, these ingredients are mixed to cook food, glucose, and oxygen is released as a byproduct into the air. Step by step: roots absorb water, leaves absorb CO2 and sunlight, chlorophyll uses sunlight's energy, food and oxygen are made. Children often confuse this with respiration, where living things take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide to get energy from food, that is the opposite direction of gases.","traps":["Saying plants eat soil as food instead of making their own food","Mixing up photosynthesis releasing oxygen with respiration releasing oxygen","Forgetting that sunlight and chlorophyll are both needed, not just water"],"misconception":"Children think plants get food directly from soil like humans eating meals, not realising they manufacture food using sunlight.","parent_questions":[{"q":"What three things does a leaf need to make food?","expected_answer_hint":"Sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide."},{"q":"What gas do plants release during photosynthesis?","expected_answer_hint":"Oxygen."}],"check_question":{"q":"Ek paudhe ko bhojan banane ke liye kaunsi cheez zaroor chahiye?","options":["Sunlight","Namak","Cement"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Sahi! Sunlight hi photosynthesis ke liye zaroori energy deta hai.","wrong_feedback":"Nahi, sochiye - bina roshni ke chlorophyll kaam nahi karta."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A green leafy plant sitting near a sunny window with sunlight rays falling on its leaves and a small kirana shop visible in the background.","labels":[{"text":"Sunlight","position":"top"},{"text":"Leaf","position":"center"},{"text":"Oxygen","position":"right"},{"text":"Water","position":"bottom-left"}]}}
